title: Mugilpete
desc: Raja and Apoorva fall head-over-heels for one another, but must overcome their families' opposing views on love. Things come to a head when Apoorva goes missing and Raja sets out to track her down.

title: UI
desc: In a dystopian world, people of all races and religions co-exist. However, misuse of power and technology creates a conflict between Sathya and Kalki.

desc: Venky and Varun brainstorm various strategies to overcome their economic challenges. However, complications arise when they cross paths with a businessman.

title: Landlord

title: Boss
